description: The plot illustrates how the number of shared routed experts (Top-6) between two independent samples varies with sample token count across six task categories. The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and uses an exponential (base-2) scale with tick labels from \(2^9\) through \(2^{20}\) at increments of one exponent. The y-axis is labeled “Shared Experts for Two Samples” and spans roughly from 2.0 up to 6.0 on a linear scale, with labeled ticks at 0.5 intervals (e.g., 2.0, 2.5, …, 6.0). Six solid lines without markers are shown: the orange Intent line starts near 3.8 at \(2^9\), rises to about 4.3 at \(2^{10}\), dips to about 3.9 at \(2^{11}\), then increases to around 5.2 at \(2^{12}\) and continues upward to approximately 6.0 by \(2^{19}\)–\(2^{20}\); the blue Summary line begins near 1.9 at \(2^9\), increases to about 3.2 at \(2^{10}\) and about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), dips slightly to about 4.5 at \(2^{12}\), then climbs to roughly 5.4 at \(2^{14}\) and approaches about 5.9–6.0 by \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\); the yellow Law line starts around 3.6 at \(2^9\), rises to about 4.2 at \(2^{10}\) and about 5.1 at \(2^{11}\), drops to about 4.6 at \(2^{12}\), then increases to about 5.6 at \(2^{13}\) and about 5.8 at \(2^{14}\), and stays near 5.9–6.0 from about \(2^{17}\) through \(2^{20}\); the purple Translation line begins around 5.1 at \(2^9\), rises to about 5.3 at \(2^{10}\), drops to about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), then increases to about 5.6 at \(2^{12}\) and gradually trends upward to about 5.9–6.0 by \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\); the gray Code line starts near 1.9 at \(2^9\), stays near 2.0 at \(2^{10}\), rises to about 2.9 at \(2^{11}\) and about 3.1 at \(2^{12}\), reaches about 3.7 at \(2^{13}\), dips to about 3.1 at \(2^{14}\), then increases to about 4.2 at \(2^{15}\), about 4.8 at \(2^{16}\), about 5.3 at \(2^{17}\)–\(2^{18}\), and ends near 5.7–5.8 at \(2^{20}\); the green Math line starts around 3.8 at \(2^9\), rises to about 4.2 at \(2^{10}\) and about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), increases to about 5.0 at \(2^{12}\) and about 5.3 at \(2^{13}\)–\(2^{14}\), then climbs to about 5.5 at \(2^{15}\), about 5.7 at \(2^{16}\), and remains near 5.9–6.0 from about \(2^{18}\) through \(2^{20}\).
caption_used: Results of the shared Top-6 routed experts in two independent samples across various task categories. The x-axis represents the sample token count on an exponential scale from 2^9 to 2^20, while the y-axis indicates the number of shared experts for two samples, ranging from 2.0 to 6.0. The line plot features six categories: Intent, Summary, Law, Translation, Code, and Math. The orange line (Intent) demonstrates a steady upward trend, starting at approximately 3.7 and reaching near 6.0, consistently outperforming other categories. The blue line (Summary) begins at 2.0, rising sharply to 5.8 by 2^11 tokens before stabilizing around 5.5. The yellow line (Law) starts at 3.5 and exhibits a gradual increase, peaking at 5.7 before slightly declining to 5.4 at 2^20. The purple line (Translation) initiates at 5.0, fluctuates minimally, and ends at 5.6, showing a modest upward trajectory. The grey line (Code) starts at 2.0, rapidly escalates to 5.9 by 2^14, and then collapses to 5.2 at 2^20. The green line (Math) begins at 3.6, steadily climbing to 5.8, and consistently surpasses the Law category throughout the token range. The legend is positioned at the bottom right for clarity.
